description: Tag-rule enforcement for knowledge-base / vector-store responses. Each test feeds the SDK a fixed corpus of documents (each with a 'tags' array) and asserts which docs survive the filterByTags step. The corpus is shared across all three SDKs.

scenarios.name: allowed-tags-keeps-only-public
scenarios.comment: allowedTags=[public] keeps every doc with 'public' in its tag list (doc1, doc4, doc6) and drops the rest.

scenarios.name: denied-tags-drops-confidential
scenarios.comment: deniedTags=[confidential] drops every doc with 'confidential' (doc3, doc6).

scenarios.name: denied-tags-precedence-over-allowed
scenarios.comment: doc6 has BOTH 'confidential' and 'public'. deniedTags must win, so doc6 is dropped despite matching allowedTags=[public].

scenarios.name: untagged-doc-fails-closed-against-allowed-tags
scenarios.comment: doc5 has tags=[]. With allowedTags set, it must be dropped — no tag means no proof of allowance.

scenarios.name: no-tag-rules-passes-everything-through
scenarios.comment: No tagRules block at all -> all docs pass through unchanged.

scenarios.name: multi-allowed-tag-union-semantics
scenarios.comment: allowedTags=[public, outcomes] keeps any doc with EITHER tag (union, not intersection): doc1, doc3, doc4, doc6.
